risk_aware_path — DRIVE roverslip op

• Data kinds: table × any × any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.risk_aware_path(cost_map, start, goal) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import roverslip; roverslip.risk_aware_path(cost_map, start, goal) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("risk_aware_path"))

Usage

8-neighbor Dijkstra (directed edges — uphill and downhill differ) on the edge travel times of cvar_cost_map.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

start・goal は (行, 列)。返り値 {"path": (n, 2) の添字, "cost": 合計の所要時間 [s] (届かなければ inf), "reached": bool, "cost_to_come": (H, W)}。届かないときは path が空。
